testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-simple-product-details-on-pdp.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify simple product details on pdp

scenario.summary: Guest searches the webstore for a simple product by SKU, opens its PDP and validates the header details (category label included), retail price, rating, three tiered offers, the checkbox add-on group and its options, stock status, action buttons and the info tabs. Read-only; nothing is added to the cart.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search for the product SKU and open the result for that SKU.
Assert image, breadcrumb Home/<category>/<name>, wishlist heart, product name, SKU, Category:<category>, brand and short description.
Assert retail price, star rating and the three tiered special offers.
Assert the 'Add-on options' heading, the checkbox add-on group label, each add-on option and the stock status.
Assert Print, See More and Email a Friend buttons; assert the Details, Specifications and Shipping Info tab panels and open Reviews.
assertions: Breadcrumb, heading, SKU:<sku>, Category:<category>, Brand:<brand> and short description match the product.
Retail price equals the recorded amount.
Three tiered offers show 'Buy N or more', '$<price>/item' and 'Save <discount>%'.
Checkbox add-on group label and each add-on option are shown; stock status contains 'In Stock'.
Details, Specifications and Shipping Info panels contain the recorded texts.
evidence: Title 'verify simple product details on pdp' and the five step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no linked AIO cases.
All data comes from loadData(SimpleDataSchema, rawData, ...) (spec line 33).

Profile: SKU z-2420004 FOUND as SimpleProduct, active, PRODUCTION, brand Black + Decker (BlackAndDecker), inventory 235, requiredAddOnCount 0, but storefrontProductIndex 0 (the key needs >= 1, so the recorded product may not pass the key as preferred).

Key PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK because the PDP must show a checkbox add-on group (data.addOnOptionType Checkbox, three options); addOnDisplayType CheckBox. The test selects no add-on; quantityUsed 1.

Gap: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK returns only sku, name, addOnProductId, addOnName, price. The asserted category, brand, short description, tier offers, all add-on option labels and tab texts have no output.
Data in code: page object test id lblAddOnGroupCheckbox carries the add-on group name (Checkbox).
migrate: data only through loadData, but expected values depend on the recorded product (retail price, tier prices, add-on option names, descriptions, specification text).

Remap 2026-11-03: Header and tabs -> product: productSKU sku, productName name, productBrand brandName, productShortDescription shortDescription, productPrice price, addOnOptionType addOnGroupName, inventory inStockMessage, productDetails details, productSpecifications specifications, productShippingInfo shippingInfo. Supersedes the Gap line.
Remap 2026-11-03: Tier offers specialOffer.buyQty1..3 / offerPrice1..3 -> product.tier1..3Qty / tier1..3Price (tiers by quantity).

Remap 2026-11-03: addOnOptions.0..2 -> product.addOn1Name..addOn3Name (display order; ties broken by product id, which may not match the PDP: the spec should check that each option is present, not its position).

Remap 2026-11-03: Not produced: productCategory ('Tools', the recorded breadcrumb) stays role data without output: categoryPath returns 'Electrical' for z-2420004 (first category by display order), which is not what the PDP breadcrumb showed.
